ctaHeading: Get Your Keilor Roof Done Right
aboutText: D Steel Roofing is Keilor's trusted local expert for roofing, roof plumbing, and roof restoration services. Proudly serving homes and businesses across Keilor and surrounding suburbs like Sunshine and Pascoe Vale. Our licensed team delivers high-quality workmanship to every roofing project, including roof install or replacement, COLORBOND®, roof plumbing, leak repair, fascia's, and gutters. Choose the roofing specialists dedicated to adding value and protection to your Keilor property.
servicesText: We offer a complete range of roofing services tailored to Keilor homes and businesses. From new installations to urgent repairs, our team ensures durable and reliable results for every project.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of new roofs using high-quality materials for long-lasting protection.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.desc: Expert removal and replacement of old or damaged roofs to restore your property's integrity.

services.title: Roof Plumbing
services.desc: Specialised roof plumbing services including vent pipes, flashing, and drainage solutions.

services.desc: Prompt and effective repair of roof leaks to prevent water damage and structural issues.

services.desc: Comprehensive roof restoration services to refresh and extend the life of your existing roof.

services.desc: Installation and repair of gutters and fascia boards to ensure proper water management.
